name: Dear Althea
source:
In "Dear Althea" you will be Althea Vane; a young upper class British woman whose life is turned upside down after the death of her father causes her family to fall apart along with her future. She will be forced to choose a new future, a place to call home and a group to belong to.
To get there she will have to face all sorts of situations in Victorian London; however, love and romance fortunately abound and will make her quest more enjoyable.  

This visual novel, full of decisions and repercussions, is a reinterpretation of the novel "Dear Faustina" (1897) by British author Rhoda Broughton.

[From [url=https://tijerinart.itch.io/dear-althea]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Dear Althea》中，你将扮演Althea Vane，一位年轻的英国上流社会女性。父亲去世后，她的家庭分崩离析，未来也随之彻底改变。她不得不为自己选择新的未来、寻找栖身之所，并找到归属的群体。

为了走出困境，她必须面对维多利亚时代伦敦的种种处境。所幸，爱情与浪漫也会让这段旅程更加愉快。

这是一部充满抉择及其后果的视觉小说，改编自英国作家罗达·布劳顿于1897年创作的小说《Dear Faustina》。

[来源：[url=https://tijerinart.itch.io/dear-althea]Itch.io[/url]]
